hook: Paradev goes fully open source again

beats.say: Paradev, formerly Superset, moved to a more restrictive license in February. Now the team has switched back to MIT.
It is a desktop app for running coding agents like Claude Code and Codex in parallel, each in its own Git worktree.
The team invites anyone to fork it or build their own product on it. Its GitHub repo has more than 16,000 stars.
